mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_shifts (job_id, template_slot_id, worker_id, shift_date, start_time, end_time, location_lat, location_lng, location_radius, location_name, status) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{templateSlotId}, #{workerId}, #{shiftDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{locationLat}, #{locationLng}, #{locationRadius}, #{locationName}, 'SCHEDULED')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schedule_shifts WHERE job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY shift_date, start_time
SELECT * FROM schedule_shifts WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} ORDER BY shift_date, start_time
SELECT * FROM schedule_shifts WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND shift_date = #{shiftDate} ORDER BY start_time
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule_shifts SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ss.* FROM schedule_shifts ss JOIN jobs j ON ss.job_id = j.id WHERE ss.worker_id = #{workerId} AND j.company_id = #{companyId} AND ss.status = 'CHECKED_OUT' ORDER BY ss.shift_date DESC
